THE ELECTRONIC MARKET FULFILLING AND FUTURISTIC OUTLOOK - Some of this was written decades ago by C. Larkin about Commercial Babylon, but I’m going to update it between paragraphs! From the Scripts, the startling fulfillment. Much of it is already in place, like an electronic brain for trading! Note: one of Rev. 18 headquarters is New York. “Babylon the Great will be an immense city, the greatest in every respect the world has ever seen. It will be a typical city, the London, the Paris, the Berlin, the Petrograd, the New York, the Chicago of its day. It will be the greatest commercial city of the world. Its merchandise will be of gold silver and precious stones and pearls, of purple, and silk, and scarlet and costly wools. Its fashionable society will be clothed in the most costly jewels. Their homes will be filled with the most costly furniture of precious woods, brass, iron and marble, with the richest of draperies, mats and rugs. They will use the most costly of perfumes, cinnamon, fragrant odors, ointments and frankincenses. Their banquet will be supplied with the sweetest of wines, the richest of pastry, and the most delicious of meats. They will have horses and chariots and the swiftest of fast moving vehicles on earth and in the air. They will have their slaves, and they will traffic in the “soul of men”. That is, women will sell their bodies, and men their souls, to gratify their lust. According to Rev. 18 and my scripts this is definitely coming to pass! Just look at the cars and air travel. Plus the god of electronics joined to the Internet has created a world wide Babylon connected to New York and other big cities! It is not just one big city, but a wheel within a wheel of commerce! Now they can trade day and night over the world. President Clinton has paved away through International trade. Plus he just signed a bill concerning 8 - 10 year old children could not be used in prostitution, pornography, and other things but it is still going on. We have never seen so many different advertisements of perfumes, styles and expensive materials. All over the world silver and gold has been stored for later use. (James 5: 1-3)

INDULGENCE of SODOM AND PAGAN ROME - The markets will be crowded with cattle, sheep and horses. The wharves will be piled with goods from all climes. The manufactures will turn out the riches of fabrics, and all that the genius can invent for the comfort and convenience of men will be found on the market. It will be a city given over to pleasure and business. Businessmen and promoters will give their days and nights to scheming how to make money fast, and the pleasure loving will be constantly planning new pleasure. There will be riotous joy and ceaseless feasting. As it was in the days of Noah and of Lot, they will be marrying and giving in marriage, buying and selling, building and planting. Through the world stock market and Internet trading and TV style shows, etc., this is already occurring! As predicted, some of the dresses are see through, near nude and even the long ones are clinging and lustful at certain locations! Over cable TV nudity and sex is practicality worldwide! Through virtual reality, methods and inventions, they are creating more ways of sensual mania. Note: The United States is actually sinking into a black hole of immorality. (Jude 1: 12-13)

CONTINUING - In the market they don’t talk about millions, now they talk about trillions of dollars. Congress say they have paid off the budget, but the nation itself is more then 7 trillion in debt. We have seen the swift and drastic way money is changing and suddenly the world will have a new system and mark. Through the 90’s new cities have sprawled out in the desert places over the earth and during the false dictator rule it will pass any thing known to man in the next few years.

CONTINUING COMMERCIAL PROPHECY - A world of merging enterprise setting snare! Plus we already see the madness of today’s music and the blood will run hot in their veins. Money will be their god, pleasure their high-Priest, and unbridled passion the ritual of their worship. “It will be a city of music. Amid the noise and bustle of its commercial life will be heard the music of its pleasure resorts and theaters. There will be the sound of ‘harpers and musicians, of pipers and trumpeters’ (Rev.18:22). The world’s best singers and players will be there. Its theatres and places of music will be going day and night. In fact, there will be no night, for the electric illumination of the city by night will make the night as bright and shadowless as the day, and its stores and places of business will never close, night nor day, nor Sunday, for the mad whirl of pleasure and the absorbing desire for riches will keep the wheels of business constantly moving. And all this will be easy because of the “god of this world.” (Read Ezek.28:4-5 -Dan 8: 2-5)

COMMERCIAL AND RELIGIOUS WIZARD - Satan, will possess the minds and bodies of men, for we read in (Rev.17:2), that Babylon at that time will be ‘the Habitation of Devils, and the Hold of Every Foul Spirit, and the Cage of Every Unclean and Hateful Bird’. The city will be the seat for the most imposing “OCCULTISM”, and mediums, and those desiring to communicate with the other world will then go to Babylon, as men and women now go to Paris for fashions and sensuous pleasures. In that day demons, disembodied souls, and diabolic spirits will find at Babylon the opportunity of their lives to materialize themselves in human bodies, and from the atmospheric heavens above. And from the Abyss below, they will come in countless legions until Babylon shall be full of demon-possessed men and women. And at the height of its glory, just before its fall, Babylon will be ruled by SATAN HIMSELF, incarnate in the ‘Beast’ - ANTICHRIST”. Doesn’t all the above sound familiar and right before our eyes daily. And the anti-Christ part will soon be be revealed! We see all the above articles taking place through internet electronic, lasers, fiber optics, cable and satellite, etc.

UNCOVERING SECOND PART OF BABYLON - The other part of Babylon is religious (Mystery Babylon) - Rev. 17 reveals just like Commercial Babylon merged, so does Mystery Babylon! All religions merge and the whore rides political beast. (Rev. 17: 1-5)

BUILDING AND DEFINITE SIGNS - Japan is said to be making buildings so high that they are called cities in the air! The bible said like the building of the Great Pyramid and Ark, Jesus said so will it be today at His appearance! The most fascinating and yet bizarre and unusual age is yet ahead as it nears its final years!

PHENOMENON 2000 - On July 1st and 31st there are two partial solar eclipses! This 2 in one month only occurs once in a lifetime! Truly significant. Plus July 16 there is a total lunar eclipse. This trio event is very rare! A dramatic sign of things to important events! (Near bottom of Scroll #274 you can read some of them)
Note: Pray for the youth! They are living in a make believe fantasy world! Only the Word can guide them out of the Abyss into the truth!
